name: Ashlan Stonesmirk
summary: At Dun Modr, Ashlan Stonesmirk watches the border with the regiment guarding the Thandol Span. The dwarven explosives expert keeps alert for dangers threatening Ironforge.

sections.title: An Expert on the Border
sections.body: At Dun Modr in the northern Wetlands, Ashlan Stonesmirk serves the regiment guarding the Thandol Span. His knowledge of explosives makes him a useful contact when suspicious materials threaten dwarven defenses.

sections.title: A Dark Threat Looms
sections.body: Chief Engineer Hinderweir finds suspicious powder near the Stonewrought Dam and sends it to Ashlan for examination. Ashlan identifies the powder as Seaforium and explains how to neutralize it.

faq.q: Where can I find Ashlan Stonesmirk?
faq.answer: Ashlan Stonesmirk is stationed at Dun Modr in the northern Wetlands, near the Thandol Span.
Ashlan Stonesmirk is a dwarven explosives expert with the regiment guarding Dun Modr and the Thandol Span. Hinderweir turns to him to identify suspicious powder found near the Stonewrought Dam.
Ashlan helps adventurers examine suspicious powder sent by Chief Engineer Hinderweir during 'A Dark Threat Looms'.

angles.text: As a dwarf, Ashlan represents the skilled specialists who support Ironforge's soldiers along Khaz Modan's borders.
Ashlan's work helps secure the strategic corridor connecting Loch Modan to the Wetlands and northern Alliance territories.
